## Production Case Studies
- DigiLawyer AI (/work/digilawyer-lcp-rag): Reduced LCP from 7.0s to 1.2s (+30% on marketing pages) using Next.js SSR/SSG and code splitting; built grounded RAG legal chatbot (30% → 90%+ accuracy, 40% fewer hallucinations).
- FrankieOne Portal (/work/frankieone-caching-mfe): Cut redundant API calls by 70% via TanStack Query caching & deduplication; migrated legacy Vue.js KYB flows to React micro-frontends.
- Costimizer AI (/work/costimizer-finops-sse): Built multi-cloud FinOps dashboards (1,000+ virtualized rows, 40% fewer React re-renders, 45% fewer API calls) and a reusable SSE streaming RAG AI chatbot package.
- FrankieOne One-SDK (/work/frankieone-one-sdk): Engineered configurable client-side KYC & biometric verification flows with 15+ calendar/date validation rules and automated retry handling (4,500+ weekly npm downloads).
